title: Pan-Seared Fish with Mediterranean Croute
description: A delicious and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared fish topped with a crispy Mediterranean croute.
instructions: 2. Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
3. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the white wine (if using).
4. Add the fish to the skillet, skin side up. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
5. Flip the fish over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
6. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
7. Meanwhile, toast the Mediterranean croute in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
8. Remove the skillet from the oven and top the fish with the honeyed butter.
10. Serve the fish with the toasted croute on top.
